title: Weather source decision: what NERV has, a free source, where it is called
goal: One free, keyless forecast source is chosen and its limits are written down before any code
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "y" to the skills panel and pre-flight skill plan (earlier: "pre flight check, ok", real data).

Found on 2026-11-26 while planning: NERV has no weather source (no weather code in src; only test strings), and Grover and Hobo expose none. The step checks and records: which free source (candidates: Open-Meteo, no key, free for non-commercial use; MET Norway; both read at the time of the step, with their terms, rate limits and attribution rules) gives wind, gusts, rain probability and temperature for a point and a day; where the call lives (a NERV read tool such as weather.forecast, or an MCP server) and why

The privacy cost is named: the call sends the spot's coordinates (rounded) to a third party, so it is a tool of effect read that needs the network and says so, off by default until the owner turns it on, never run for local-only requests; where the spot comes from (the owner's saved flying spots in FPVBuddy or Hobo over MCP, or the coordinates given in the request) is decided and written; the Italian wording of the forecast lines ("vento", "raffiche", "pioggia") is fixed

The page docs/decisions/weather-source.md records the choice, the alternatives and the free-tier limits; if no free source meets the need, the step says so and F-146-T02 is cancelled with the reason (the checklist then says "meteo non disponibile")
privacy: Neutral invented skills, fleets, spots and weather only; no owner data, tokens or coordinates of a real place in Git or tests.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A visible change in how a section looks or behaves goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: reading two providers' terms and writing one page. Not a measurement.
